legend: Cellular nodule with scant hyalinization and central necrosis.
Edges are less well defined, with small clusters of loose cells (pseudopods) that mimic invasion.
Cohesive nests and cords of chorion laeve–type intermediate trophoblast with cytological and nuclear atypia.
Small (< 5 mm), circumscribed, paucicellular hyalinized nodules composed of intermediate trophoblast.
